parameters.help_en:
The ID of the namespace. You can call the ListUserDefineRegion operation to query the namespace ID. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/149377.html.

If this parameter is left empty, the clusters in the default namespace are queried.

If this parameter is specified, the clusters in the specified namespace are queried
parameters.help_zh:
命名空间的ID。查询命名空间ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/149377.html。
未设置该参数，则查询默认命名空间的集群列表。
设置该参数，则查询指定命名空间的集群列表
parameters.name: logical_region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group. You can call the ListResourceGroup operation to query the resource group ID. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/62055.html.

If this parameter is left empty, the clusters in the default resource group are queried.

If this parameter is specified, the clusters in the specified resource group are queried
parameters.help_zh:
资源组ID。查询资源组ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/62055.html。
未设置该参数，则查询默认资源组的集群列表。
设置该参数，则查询指定资源组的集群列表
parameters.name: resource_group_id

ClusterId.description_en: The ID of the cluster in EDAS

ClusterType.description_en:
The type of the cluster. Valid values:

0: regular Docker cluster

1: Swarm cluster

2: Elastic Compute Service (ECS) cluster

3: self-managed Kubernetes cluster in Enterprise Distributed Application Service (EDAS)

4: cluster in which Pandora automatically registers applications

5: ACK cluster
ClusterType.description_zh:
集群类型。
0：普通Docker集群
1：Swarm集群
2：ECS集群
3：EDAS自建K8s集群
4：Pandora自动注册应用集群
5：容器服务K8s集群

Cpu.description_en: The total number of CPU cores

CpuUsed.description_en: The number of used CPU cores

CreateTime.description_en: The timestamp when the cluster was created. This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC

CsClusterId.description_en: The ID of the cluster in Container Service for Kubernetes (ACK)
CsClusterId.description_zh: 容器服务Kubernetes版中创建的K8s集群的ID

Mem.description_en: The total size of memory. Unit: MB

MemUsed.description_en: The size of used memory. Unit: MB

NetworkMode.description_en:
The network type of the cluster. Valid values:

1: classic network

2: virtual private cloud (VPC)

OversoldFactor.description_en:
The CPU overcommit ratio that is supported by a Docker cluster. Valid values:

1: 1:1, which means that CPU resources are not overcommitted.

2: 1:2, which means that CPU resources are overcommitted by 1:2.

4: 1:4, which means that CPU resources are overcommitted by 1:4.

8: 1:8, which means that CPU resources are overcommitted by 1:8
OversoldFactor.description_zh:
Docker集群支持的CPU超卖比例。
1：1:1比例，不超卖
2：1:2比例
4：1:4比例
8：1:8比例

ResourceGroupId.description_en: The ID of the resource group

UpdateTime.description_en: The timestamp when the cluster was last modified. This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
UpdateTime.description_zh: 最后变更时间的时间戳

Code.description_en: The HTTP status code that is returned

Message.description_en: The additional information that is returned
